_note: Worked example only. The tool applies to any B2B product; replace every value with your own brand, ICP, and scenarios. See README > Inputs.

icp.role: Head of Sales who also owns Sales Ops
icp.description: B2B SaaS company, 120 sales reps, mid-market ACV around 40k USD.
jobs_to_be_done: hit the quarterly revenue number and defend the forecast to the CEO and board
diagnose why deals stall and fix the pipeline process
build a repeatable coaching program so rep performance doesn't depend on tribal knowledge
priorities: forecast accuracy above all: the board has lost patience with 20 percent misses
get value fast without a heavy implementation project
prove ROI on any new tooling within two quarters
icp.buying_moment: Third consecutive forecast miss just landed and the board told the CEO it is unacceptable; I have roughly one quarter to show the number can be trusted before this becomes a question about me.
decision_criteria: provable forecast-accuracy improvement within two quarters
works on top of Salesforce as-is, no CRM cleanup project first
light enough to run without a dedicated admin
defensible to the board: reference customers at our size I can call

positioning: Gong captures and analyzes every customer interaction so revenue teams see what actually happened in deals, not what reps report happened.
Deal and pipeline intelligence surfaces stalled and at-risk deals with the reasons, replacing opinion-driven pipeline reviews with reality.
AI-driven coaching turns real call data into repeatable rep development, so performance stops depending on tribal knowledge.
Forecasts are grounded in conversation signal, not just CRM stage hygiene.

scenarios.situation: Deals keep stalling after the demo and nobody can tell me why. Reps swear the calls went great, then the account goes dark and I have no independent read on what actually happened in those conversations.

The board just told me a third consecutive forecast miss is unacceptable. My pipeline reviews are opinion-driven: every rep swears their deals will close and I have no independent signal to challenge them with. I need to walk into the next board meeting with a forecast I can actually defend.

My rep coaching is whoever I happen to sit in with that week. New hires ramp slowly and my best reps' habits never make it to the rest of the team, so performance lives and dies on tribal knowledge I cannot scale.
